headline: AI Engineer
summary: AI engineer who ships LLM features with evals: an open-source ticket router and a RAG assistant measured on real questions.

bullets.text: Built TicketRouter, an open-source LLM router that tags and prioritises 1,500 tickets a week at 94% tag accuracy for 3 teams.
Shipped a RAG assistant over a 2,000-page policy wiki; 87% accuracy on an eval set of 120 real support questions.
Automated entry of 600 invoices a month with an n8n flow and an LLM extractor, cutting manual work from 30 to 4 hours a month.
